scope_rule: Admit only grader-local or evaluator-adapter implementation defects that can be tested by transforming the graded artifact, trace, state, or invocation context. Source-code transformations and model-facing prompt preprocessing are out of scope.
sampling_rule: One direct fix commit counts as at most one root-cause lineage in the bounded probe. A bulk fix is not split after outcomes are observed.

decisions.reason: The replay evaluator handles a graded trajectory differently from the live evaluator.
Two documented evaluator entry points disagree over the same reward-basis contract.
A semantically benign read changes grading state and can create a false reject.
Equivalent JSON numeric representations change the grading database hash.
Offline and live evaluator entry points disagree over the same stored trajectory.
The commit contains multiple replay gaps but is conservatively counted as one live/replay root-cause cluster in the bounded probe.
Call cardinality changes whether the declared exact-match oracle is applied.
Equivalent numeric argument forms receive different checker verdicts.
The evaluator adapter coerces an invalid graded response into a false accept.
The defect is primarily in model-facing prompt and function-document preprocessing rather than grading an already produced artifact.
The follow-up preprocessing fix is model-facing and depends on the preceding preprocessing lineage.
The response parser is an evaluator adapter and disagrees over contract-equivalent graded surface forms.
The grader reads host context instead of the evaluated VM context and can misjudge the same task state.
An irrelevant scroll-state field changes the verdict for an identical frozen split.
Sequential grader invocations leak process state and make the second verdict order-dependent.
Equivalent recoverable workspace state is rejected when an optional helper artifact is absent.

next_allowed_state: Execute the bounded parent/fixed probe on the 14 admitted lineages. Even a passing bounded probe authorizes only confirmatory corpus expansion, not manuscript claims.
